candidates.explanation: After the forgot-password hash is verified, resetPassword only sets the new password and updates the user. It never revokes the user's existing sessions. Refresh tokens are validated against session records (refreshToken calls sessionService.updateByHash), so a phone that was already signed in keeps a valid session and can still renew its login. The update() method does call deleteByUserIdWithExclude on a password change, but resetPassword has no equivalent.

fix.description: After updating the password in resetPassword, call `await this.sessionService.deleteByUserId({ userId: user.id });` to revoke all of the user's sessions. This invalidates every device's refresh token.
